findingDetails.title: tool-surface.md inverts the truth about the primitive verbs: declares them top-level aliases and calls the real create-subcommand form drift
_common.sh resolves figma-cli without the silships identity check SKILL.md makes mandatory
connect-safe.sh exits 0 after doing nothing whenever stdin is not a TTY
doctor.sh resolves .utcp_config.json one level above the repo root once vendored, so the optional-MCP check false-negatives
README and INSTALL-GUIDE invoke extract with a --out flag the binary does not define, at a fixed path the packet's own no-overwrite rule forbids
seven cross-references resolve only at the upstream nesting depth, so they are dangling in the position the packet ships in
install.sh --verbose test can never be false, so the quiet branch is dead
INSTALL-GUIDE version metadata trails the packet at 1.0.0.0 while SKILL.md and README declare 1.1.3.0
vendor-sync.py can write a null base_commit and then report in step at None
nothing the packet executes is pinned or integrity-checked: install.sh clones the default branch and runs npm install -g, the MCP manual uses figma-developer-mcp@latest
the optional MCP path pipes arbitrary Figma-authored text into the model with no untrusted-content instruction
playbook index pins the skill at 1.0.0.0 while the packet declares 1.1.3.0
two of the playbook's three pointers to its own scenario cross-reference index name Section 12 instead of Section 13
INSTALL-GUIDE describes extract output as 9 sections while the reference and catalog say 11
the Code Mode manual entry is copied in five places and the copies have already diverged on the version pin
the daemon PID constant re-introduces the figma-cli name collision the packet warns about, and doctor reports its contents unvalidated
the official Dev Mode MCP out-of-scope sentence reads repo-wide while sk-create-figjam ships that route as its primary one

results.notes: Re-verified against the manifest and tree.
No checklist.md in the staging folder.
Command sweep over all 58 files found only the create-primitives token unrecognised.
Structure verified; 12 of 17 scenarios not audited line by line.

detail: R1-P1-001 scope widened on replay: the inverted create-primitives conclusion is repeated at feature-catalog/feature-catalog.md:18, :120 and feature-catalog/render-and-create/render-and-create.md:28, so remediation spans three files, not one

R3-P1-001 impact re-read on replay: the optional-path mechanics are also stated inline in mcp-wiring.md sections 3 and 4, so the dead links are redundant guidance; the grade is kept and flagged as the first downgrade candidate

vendor-sync.py is gated: run_gates.sh runs vendor-sync.py status and test_vendor_sync.py, and the suite covers in-step, local-ahead refusal, symlink refusal, push, upstream-moved refusal, re-baseline and include scoping

direction: unconfirmed destructive path reachable from documentation
reason: yolo connect refuses without the consent flag, unpatch is the stated rollback, arrange is labeled destructive by the binary and the packet, and every destructive verb is in the confirm-plus-target-plus-rollback set

direction: credential leak via the three scripts not previously read
reason: setup.sh, print-utcp-snippets.sh and unpatch.sh never read or print the token; the token-shaped scan remains empty
58 files on disk, 58 in the manifest, 58 upstream, byte-identical
